pages.text: I can sacrifice quantity to force a material upward through a curated chain.

$(bold)Mana:$() ¼ bucket$(br)$(bold)Mode:$() Instant$(br2)The offhand item chooses the source; matching items may be drawn from the rest of inventory. Each cast consumes ten and creates one: Coal→Raw Copper→Raw Iron→Lapis→Redstone→Diamond→Emerald. Gold is excluded. The cast fails without ten inputs or room for the output.
